title: Exploring our school
summary: Practise school places, people's jobs and rules for getting along.
keyIdeas: School is a place to learn, spend time together and make friends.
Many people work at school to care for and help us.
Following rules and caring for materials help us get along.

basicKnowledge: C. Sociedades y territorios › Alfabetización cívica

activities.prompt: Where at school do we read and borrow books?
activities.explanation: The library is a quiet place where school books are kept and read.
activities.hint: It is a quiet place full of stories and shelves.

activities.prompt: In class, we raise our hands to ask for a turn to speak.
activities.explanation: Raising a hand helps us listen respectfully without interrupting others.

activities.prompt: Match each school worker to their job.
activities.explanation: Everyone at school has an important job that helps it run well.

pairs.right: Opens doors and looks after the building
Prepares food for the dining room

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence about a school morning.
activities.explanation: Break time is a pause to rest and play.
activities.sentence: The pause for rest and play at school is called ___.

activities.prompt: Sort these school spaces by their main use.
activities.explanation: In this exercise, classrooms and libraries are for studying, while playgrounds and gyms are for movement.

activities.prompt: Put these parts of Hugo's school day in order.
activities.explanation: Hugo arrives, works in class, plays at break and goes home at the end.
items: He arrives at school in the morning
He learns and works in class
He plays with friends at break
He goes home when school finishes

activities.prompt: Aisha and Leo want the same ball. What should they do?
activities.explanation: Talking and sharing help everyone enjoy playing together.
activities.hint: Find a way for both children to play.
options: Share the ball and take turns
Grab the ball and run away
Get angry and never speak again

activities.prompt: Caring for classroom materials helps them last longer.
activities.explanation: Looking after books, crayons and games keeps them ready to use.

activities.prompt: Marcos has paper scraps on his desk. What should he do?
activities.explanation: We help keep our workspaces clean and tidy.
activities.hint: Everyone can help keep the classroom tidy.
options: Put the paper in the recycling bin
Leave the paper on the classroom floor
Wait for someone else to clean his space

activities.prompt: Read carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Martín cares for his things, greets his teacher and shares with a classmate.
activities.title: A day at Martín's school
activities.text: Martín arrives at school smiling. He greets his teacher Elena at the door. In class, he learns numbers and draws with crayons. At break, he shares his apple with Sofía. At the end, he puts away his pencils and packs his bag.

questions.prompt: Who does Martín greet when he arrives?
questions.explanation: Martín greets his teacher Elena at the door.

questions.prompt: Why does Martín put away his pencils?
questions.explanation: Tidying materials helps care for classroom things and prepare for the next day.
options: He does not want to return to school
To leave the classroom clean and tidy
